name: czrecoil_frame_on_size
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnSize runs the CZGameFrame size handler and deactivates the app for minimized/iconic size types.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431b10 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431b10 validates the CZGameFrame::OnSize call followed by app vtable OnAppDeactivate when nType is 4 or 1.
The native smoke patches the base CZGameFrame::OnSize provider path and verifies no deactivate callback for nType 0, one callback for nType 1, and a second callback for nType 4.
